sourceRefs.locator: Introduction, opening paragraphs through note 4. Odoacer in 476, the eastern emperor Zeno’s mandate, the Italian campaign in 489, the agreement and killing in 493, and Theoderic’s death in 526.
Pars posterior 49–51. The imperial commission, the Isonzo and Odoacer’s camp on a plain outside Verona before the battle.

summary.de: Theoderichs Verband ging aus den Auseinandersetzungen mehrerer Anführer auf dem Balkan hervor. In Italien schlossen sich Teile des Heeres seines Gegners an.
summary.en: Theoderic’s following emerged from rivalry among several leaders in the Balkans. In Italy men from the opposing army also joined him.
